description: First 50 seeds only - testing 'starting well' quality

scoring_criteria.9: Perfect native speech in both languages
scoring_criteria.1-2: Marginal, no one would say this

worst_3_phrases.english: I want to find out what is after you finish.
worst_3_phrases.other: Quiero saber cuál es despues de que termines.
worst_3_phrases.reason: English is nonsensical - 'what is after' is incomplete and unclear. The sentence structure is broken.

worst_3_phrases.english: I'm going to be nearly speaking English before I have to go.
worst_3_phrases.other: Voy a estar casi hablando ingles antes de que tenga que ir.
worst_3_phrases.reason: Awkward English - 'nearly speaking' is unnatural. No one would say 'I'm going to be nearly speaking'. Should be 'I'll almost be speaking' or restructured entirely.

worst_3_phrases.english: I'm going to start talking English with people who speak English.
worst_3_phrases.other: Voy a empezar hablando ingles con personas que hablan ingles.
worst_3_phrases.reason: Wrong collocation - 'talking English' should be 'speaking English'. 'Talk' takes 'in English' not 'English' directly.

other_notable_issues.english: He is taking too much time to speak English.
other_notable_issues.other: El esta tomando demasiado tiempo para hablar ingles.
other_notable_issues.reason: Awkward phrasing - 'taking too long' is more natural than 'taking too much time'. Spanish also uses calque 'tomando tiempo'.
Statement/question mismatch - Spanish is clearly a question (punctuation), but English is a statement. Inconsistent intent.

phrases.english: It's possible to speak English now.
phrases.other: Es posible hablar ingles ahora.

phrases.english: I want to learn her name because I want to speak with her.
phrases.other: Quiero aprender su nombre porque quiero hablar con ella.

phrases.english: remember very well
phrases.other: recordar muy bien

phrases.english: I want to learn to speak English.
phrases.other: Quiero aprender a hablar ingles.
phrases.notes: Perfect in both languages. Core learner motivation phrase.

phrases.english: I want to learn a word in English with someone.
phrases.other: Quiero aprender una palabra en ingles con alguien.
phrases.notes: Slightly odd - 'learn a word with someone' is unusual phrasing. Functional but not idiomatic.

phrases.english: I speak a little English with someone else now.
phrases.other: Hablo un poco de ingles con alguien mas ahora.
phrases.notes: Slightly awkward word order with 'someone else now', but acceptable.

phrases.english: I'm going to be nearly speaking English before I have to go.
phrases.other: Voy a estar casi hablando ingles antes de que tenga que ir.
phrases.notes: AWKWARD: 'nearly speaking' is unnatural English. No native would use this construction.

phrases.english: I'm going to speak in English as often as possible.
phrases.other: Voy a hablar en ingles lo mas posible.

phrases.english: I'm trying to speak English.
phrases.other: Estoy intentando hablar ingles.

phrases.english: I want to practise speaking English with you.
phrases.other: Quiero practicar hablar ingles contigo.

phrases.english: I wouldn't like to remember
phrases.other: no me gustaria recordar
phrases.notes: Awkward English - 'I wouldn't want to remember' more natural than 'wouldn't like to remember'.

phrases.english: learn as often as possible
phrases.other: aprender lo mas posible

phrases.english: I'm not sure if she wants to come back later on.
phrases.other: No estoy seguro si ella quiere volver mas tarde.

phrases.english: trying to remember English
phrases.other: tratando de recordar ingles
phrases.notes: Odd semantics - you remember words/phrases, not 'English' as a language. Functional but unnatural.

phrases.english: Now I want to speak English with you.
phrases.other: Ahora quiero hablar ingles contigo.

phrases.english: remember the whole sentence
phrases.other: recordar toda la frase
phrases.notes: Good fragments, useful for language learning context.

phrases.english: how to speak with you
phrases.other: como hablar contigo

phrases.english: I want to speak in English as often as possible.
phrases.other: Quiero hablar en ingles lo mas posible.

phrases.english: I'm going to try to say something.
phrases.other: Voy a intentar decir algo.

phrases.english: I want to speak English with you
phrases.other: quiero hablar ingles contigo

phrases.english: we don't want to interrupt
phrases.other: no queremos interrumpir

phrases.english: I'm going to say the whole sentence now.
phrases.other: Voy a decir toda la frase ahora.

phrases.english: I want to speak English now with you.
phrases.other: Yo quiero hablar ingles ahora contigo.
phrases.notes: Awkward English word order - 'now with you' should be 'with you now'. Spanish has unnecessary 'Yo'.

phrases.english: I'd like to speak English with everyone else.
phrases.other: Me gustaria hablar ingles con todos los demas.

phrases.english: because I don't want to
phrases.other: porque no quiero

phrases.english: I want to remember how to say something in English.
phrases.other: Quiero recordar como decir algo en ingles.

phrases.english: I'm going to speak English with you as often as possible.
phrases.other: Voy a hablar ingles contigo lo mas posible.

phrases.english: I'm going to start talking English with people who speak English.
phrases.other: Voy a empezar hablando ingles con personas que hablan ingles.
phrases.notes: WRONG COLLOCATION: 'talking English' should be 'speaking English'. You 'talk in English' or 'speak English', not 'talk English'.

phrases.english: Are you learning English because you want to meet people?
phrases.other: Estas aprendiendo ingles porque quieres conocer a personas?
phrases.notes: Good, though Spanish 'conocer gente' more idiomatic than 'conocer a personas'.

phrases.english: I'm trying to speak English.
phrases.other: Estoy tratando de hablar ingles.

phrases.english: I'm not sure if he wants to come back with everyone else.
phrases.other: No estoy seguro si el quiere volver con todos los demas.

phrases.english: I want to find out what is after you finish.
phrases.other: Quiero saber cual es despues de que termines.
phrases.notes: BROKEN: English is nonsensical - 'what is after' is incomplete/unclear. Both versions have semantic problems.

phrases.english: you wanted to speak
phrases.other: querias hablar

phrases.english: I'm trying to speak English as often as possible.
phrases.other: Estoy intentando hablar ingles lo mas posible.

phrases.english: It's useful to try to speak very well before tomorrow.
phrases.other: Es util intentar hablar muy bien antes de manana.
phrases.notes: Slightly odd concept but grammatically correct in both.

phrases.english: I want to learn how to speak English with you now.
phrases.other: Quiero aprender como hablar ingles contigo ahora.

phrases.english: I've been trying to speak English better.
phrases.other: Llevo intentando hablar ingles mejor.
phrases.notes: Good. Spanish uses 'llevar + gerund' construction well.

phrases.english: I like feeling as if I'm speaking with people.
phrases.other: Me gusta sentirme como si estuviera hablando con personas.

phrases.english: to read this afternoon
phrases.other: leer esta tarde

phrases.english: And I'm going to try to speak English tomorrow.
phrases.other: Y voy a intentar hablar ingles manana.

phrases.english: You want to learn his name.
phrases.other: Quieres aprender su nombre.

phrases.english: Why are you learning her name? Because I want to.
phrases.other: Por que estas aprendiendo su nombre? Porque quiero.

phrases.english: I'm trying to learn how to speak.
phrases.other: Estoy intentando aprender como hablar.

phrases.english: later on tomorrow
phrases.other: mas tarde manana
phrases.notes: Slightly redundant - 'later on' and 'tomorrow' together is unusual, but acceptable.

phrases.english: It's hard to explain something quickly in English.
phrases.other: Es dificil explicar algo rapidamente en ingles.

phrases.english: He is taking too much time to speak English.
phrases.other: El esta tomando demasiado tiempo para hablar ingles.
phrases.notes: AWKWARD: 'taking too long' is much more natural than 'taking too much time'. Spanish also uses calque.

phrases.english: Are you going to be able to help me before I have to speak more English?
phrases.other: Vas a poder ayudarme antes de que tenga que hablar mas ingles?
phrases.notes: Good complex sentence, natural in both.

phrases.english: I'm not sure if he wants to come back later on.
phrases.other: No estoy seguro si el quiere volver mas tarde.

phrases.english: remember his name
phrases.other: recordar su nombre

phrases.english: You want to speak English.
phrases.other: Tu quieres hablar ingles?
phrases.notes: MISMATCH: Spanish is a question (with question mark), English is a statement. Inconsistent communicative intent.
